answer: Here is a specific defense: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the trellis to sunk effort, uses the delta as an corroborating signal, then requires a plume before any payout.
